title: CLAVIS improvement loop: pre-registered stopping rule

baseline.method: CLAVIS = S_final(TINS) * p(d), d = DINOv2 ViT-B/14, m=2, K=zs5, support 12 / calib 4
baseline.metric: AUROC (%), mean over order seeds 123,124,125, upstream get_measures

big_step_criterion.near: new near AUROC >= baseline + 3.0 on dev1 AND on dev2
big_step_criterion.far: new far AUROC >= baseline - 0.3 on dev1 AND on dev2

constraints: ID data: only TINS's 16-shot list per class (no extra ID images)
visual backbone: DINOv2 family, any size (compute reported)
test-time adaptation within a stream is allowed (as in TINS); order seeds as before
no access to OpenOOD test lists or val_imagenet during development

procedure.confirm: a frozen candidate is evaluated once on dev2; at most 3 dev2 looks; each look is logged in iter/dev2_looks.jsonl
procedure.if_dev2_budget_exhausted: build dev3 (new held-out classes and images) before any further confirmation
procedure.test: when a candidate meets the criterion on dev1 and dev2: pre-register (sha256) and evaluate once on OpenOOD v1.5 ImageNet-1K test (second use of the test split overall); report whatever the result; stop
